summary: Results book for VD-05-064, the CVL azaheterocycle route scout and first analogue delivery for Corvenlea Pharma. It lists the 32 analogues, records the revised heteroaryl coupling sequence that removed the late-stage purification, and sets out the release checks on the delivery batch.

sheets.name: Summary
rows: The heteroaryl coupling now runs before the amide, so the late-stage column is gone. The sequence is in the route sheet.
Delivery batch released. Corvenlea has the cards and the next biology batch is queued.

sheets.name: Route

rows.v: Route: CVL aminopyrimidine core, revised sequence

rows: Pyrimidine core build from the amidine and enaminone
Heteroaryl coupling, Pd catalyst, K3PO4, dioxane/water, 90 C
Moved forward. Coupling is clean on the model pyridine so the crude goes straight into step 3.
Amide formation with the acid chloride, DIPEA, DCM
Previously the last step with a difficult column. Now the crude is clean enough to wash and crystallise.
Applied to the basic members only. Free bases for the rest.
Passed on the revised sequence. Route risk is now the supply of the boronic acids for the three most hindered analogues.

sheets.name: Delivery batch

rows.v: Compounds delivered to Corvenlea Pharma for the first biology batch

rows: Yield is isolated. Purity is LCMS and HPLC area % at 254 nm. Amounts are delivered mg per compound.
Release checks: identity by LCMS and 1H NMR, purity against the study plan, residual solvent by GC on the first five members only.

comments.text: Residual solvent results for the first five not yet in the LIMS record.
comments.author: Clara Fenwick
